overview.description: The Global X S&P 500 U.S. Market Leaders Top 50 ETF (FLAG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of the top 50 US companies listed in the S&P 500, selected based on high revenue and strong performance metrics, providing exposure primarily to US large-cap market leaders. FLAG was launched on Apr 15, 2025 and is issued by Global X.
